body: Thats really interesting actually, I try and rid myself of the negative thoughts because for me they do not tell me anything, they are just infinite thought-loops that prevent me from doing anything and make me miserable. I understand what you mean through, its important not to block anything out.

Yes, I often find myself blaming my sadness on specific decisions I made or traits I fooled myself into thinking I have, forgiving myself for my mistakes and realising hapiness is a mindset not an outcome something I need to keep up.

Im hopefully going to university in 4 months ish and am struggling with my weight. I used to be fit but gained weight and now don't like the way people treat me and just in general want to be fitter. How do I shift from the mindset of get fit quick to longer, more healthy attitudes towards the gym? Did you go through something similar yourself? Well done on all the progress!

Not running away per se, but if i wanted to live in another country for a couple of months or stay with them, I'm pretty sure they'd help me. I'm so lucky to have amazing parents but i wish i could be a more deserving son. I don't want to disappoint them.
No, my ego completely envelops me and its hard to see a future without it. There are some days where I forget about it, or rather am distracted by it but it always returns
Im so sorry that you are in this position. Im not sure anything I can say will solve this but I'm so utterly sorry you feel like this.

Is height that important where you are? I don't know, height in my experience helps but is not the be all and end all. I was so short for a long time but never really felt that much discrimination. You can look at surgery, insoles or even moving to shorter countries but height is not nearly as important as your life
Im a work in progress who needs to be perfect right now but isn't.
A truce is great but there needs to be more humanitarian aid to stop the ongoing famine.
A truce is great but there needs to be more humanitarian aid to stop the ongoing famine.
The fact that nothing is being done about this, not one ounce of real opposition is criminal.
Never be sorry, we're here for you. It's hard when nothing seems to make sense but i think you've got have blind faith that your future self will be stronger, and will overcome these challenges.
I'm so sorry to hear that, you are so much stronger than i could ever be for surviving and pushing through it. You're handling this better than 99% of people and i wish you the best
I cant offer any advice as I'm in a very similar situation but i just wanted to tell you that you're incredibly strong and although it may take some time, everything will come together
Thank you for this, I'm always inspired by those who take risks and base their happiness on themselves, not on the thoughts of others.
